icons.name: Browser
icons.label: Web Browser
icons.description: Web browser with globe or window

generation.prompt:
Generate a 2x4 grid of 8 minimalist grayscale monochrome icons on transparent background (PNG). Icons are numbered top-left to bottom-right:

1. Web browser (globe/window icon)
2. Game controller (gamepad icon)
3. Code editor/IDE (window with code brackets)
4. Music app (speaker/musical note)
5. Video camera (camera icon)
6. Storage box (package/box icon)
7. Lightning bolt (alert symbol)
8. [EMPTY - leave this slot blank/transparent]

Style requirements:
- Flat design, minimalist
- Black/gray colors only (grayscale/monochrome)
- Each icon same size and clearly distinct
- High contrast for visibility
- Transparent background (PNG)
- Grid layout: 2 rows × 4 columns
- Recommended total size: 4096x2048 pixels (512x512 per icon)
- Each icon should be recognizable and simple
